tuples.subject: penal_charges
tuples.special_circumstance: NPA accounts; penal charges reversed to the extent they remain uncollected for the specific purpose of non-recognition of income
tuples.quote: In respect of NPA accounts, penal charges shall be reversed to the extent it remains uncollected for the specific purpose of non-recognition of income.

tuples.subject: other
tuples.special_circumstance: NPA accounts; after reversal for non-recognition of income, penal charges form total liability unless waived as per the bank's policy
tuples.quote: However, the same shall be part of the total liability of the borrower to the bank, unless it is waived as per the bank's policy.
